The reference architecture's gender gate is deliberately NOT imported: the audited species data carries no gender field to read.

steps: 4. else compatible iff group sets intersect (share >= 1 — #77's rule)
5. an individual in egg state cannot be a breeding resident (#106: the egg record IS an individual in egg state)
